status: All product pictures come from the repository README’s native captures in docs/screenshots/readme/. They show a disposable demo repository in a clean release build of 025eaf40bf3b1f565b4488bd4434e2e3b1c6c141 on Omarchy 4.5. Eight sources are single window grabs. Three are sheets composed from native frames. Ten site PNGs are byte-for-byte copies. The desktop sheet and three responsive tour WebPs are full-frame downscales. Each derivative records its source hash and method.

assets.identity: 025eaf40bf3b1f565b4488bd4434e2e3b1c6c141, clean release, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, rustc 1.99.0; M2 Pro MacBook Pro, Omarchy 4.5.0-3, Hyprland 0.56.2 on native Wayland at scale 2; Omarchy theme following a stock Tokyo Night; History, project list on, ccb54bc selected with its seven changed files; window grab, 2960x1946

assets.method: Resize the complete 2960 × 1946 opaque sRGB capture to 1200 × 789 with ImageMagick 7.1.2-35, then encode those pixels with libwebp 1.6.0. Commands: magick <source> -filter Lanczos -resize 1200x -depth 8 PNG24:scaled.png ; cwebp -quiet -lossless -m 6 scaled.png -o <site_path>.
